description: Hand-labeled evaluation set. 'expected_subject' = the canonical subject of the correct image for the post (the corpus holds several equally-correct images per subject, so labels are subject-level: any correctly-ranked fox counts for a fox post). Top-1 precision is measured over these. 'expected_rejection' = no corpus image is suitable; the system must answer no_confident_match.
